letter_deductions.deduction: Claim not admissible: Hernia 24-month specific waiting period not completed (Clause 6.3)
letter_deductions.why: Inception 10-Jan-2024 to admission 20-Aug-2026 is >30 months continuous cover, so the 24-month wait (6.3 i.12) was complete.

notes: Rejection wrong unless the SI was enhanced or cover broken - nothing in the documents suggests either. Payable computed as for an admissible claim.
